```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      chocolate == TRUE ~ "chocolate",
      fruity == TRUE    ~ "fruity",
      hard == TRUE      ~ "hard candy",
      TRUE              ~ "other"
    ),
    value_score = winpercent / pricepercent
  )

count(candy, type)

```

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = nrow(candy))


```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "secondary",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))
```

## Row 2

```{r}
#| label: Best Bang For Your Buck 

BBFYB <- ggplot(data = candy, aes(x = pricepercent, y = winpercent, color = type, text = competitorname)) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 18) + 
  labs (title = "BEST BANG FOR YOUR BUCK",
        y = "Win Percent",
        x = "Price Percent",
        color = "Type of Candy")

ggplotly(BBFYB)

```

```{r}



# pricepercent : Percenetaile 
# winpercent: percent
```
